notes: MLS Assist v1.32 — Copy every visit. From an OPEN patient chart in athenaOne, MLS Assist now walks the encounters/visits list, opens and reads EVERY visit (date, type/procedure, ICD-10/CPT, full note), and streams live progress to MLS, which saves them as a structured per-visit history with a comprehensive AI summary per visit. Read-only in athenaOne — it never clicks Save/Sign; every capture still passes the strict name + DOB verify gate. Encounter-list selectors are content-scored and tunable (chrome.storage mlsAthenaVisitsCfg); one live tuning pass to your athenaOne chart is recommended. Mode C procedure-search grab and all prior features are unchanged. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
